evidence_class: PRE-IMPLEMENTATION RANKING plus post-test status; qualitative expectations are not scores
ranking_record: H6-1 was pre-registered before its implementation in evidence/session6_hypotheses.json. The remaining geological candidates were not implemented in this session.
novelty_scope: Not previously tested in this repository; not a claim of global scientific novelty.

ranked.hypothesis: Visible-catalogue proximity pruning removes redundant near-trace allocations without removing new-strand credit.
ranked.physical_signature: Euclidean distance transform to the visible catalogue; remove allocated cells at distance <=2 pixels and compare with an equal-count fixed-seed random prune.
ranked.why_missing_faults_not_catalogued_faults: The organizer clarified that proximity to a known trace earns no credit by itself. The test asks whether near-trace allocations are catalogue redundancy while detached relay/splay allocations retain recoverable hidden-strand signal.
ranked.difference_from_repo: Earlier file-level evidence compared two owner-reported live rasters. No fold-visible, equal-count random-pruning holdout test existed.
ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Highest prior plausibility, but expected magnitude small because E2 allocation already masks known pixels.
ranked.implementation_cost: Low; one CPU experiment, no external data.
ranked.data_obtainability: All required hash-pinned local layers verified.
ranked.status: TESTED; NEGATIVE under the predeclared promotion rule. See evidence/h6_1_proximity_pruning_holdout.json.

ranked.hypothesis: Visible fault-tip termination anatomy predicts short growth splays and relay breaches beyond mapped component ends.
ranked.physical_signature: Signed along-strike distance beyond each visible component endpoint, endpoint tangent persistence, and endpoint-local scarp concordance, all measured against matched mid-wall controls.
ranked.why_missing_faults_not_catalogued_faults: Regional maps can capture the mature master trace while omitting immature splays or relay breaches extending from a mapped termination.
ranked.difference_from_repo: The repo models nearest-host offsets, bends, two-host relays and slip transitions, but has no endpoint-distance or endpoint-versus-mid-wall term.
ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Medium; direct fault-growth mechanism but endpoint artifacts are common.
ranked.non_fault_mimic: Map-sheet clipping, digitization endpoints, and eroded range-front scarps.
ranked.data_obtainability: All required layers are local; no new external data.

ranked.hypothesis: Branch-density gradients around long visible faults identify horsetail damage zones while rejecting uniformly dense mapped networks.
layers: multi-radius visible-fault density at 300 m, 900 m, and 1500 m
ranked.physical_signature: Radial derivative of visible branch density and local orientation entropy, conditioned on host length and strike-slip sense; no textbook angle is imposed.
ranked.why_missing_faults_not_catalogued_faults: A mapped long master fault may be surrounded by an incompletely mapped outward-fanning population of short secondary strands whose density decays across the damage zone.
ranked.difference_from_repo: The existing anatomy has one 500 m density count; it does not model a fitted multi-radius density gradient or axial orientation entropy.
ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Medium-low; mechanistically aligned but partly correlated with E2 relay geometry.
ranked.implementation_cost: Medium; CPU convolutions and visible-only orientation histograms.
ranked.non_fault_mimic: Dense lithologic contacts and cartographic generalization around complex bedrock exposures.
ranked.data_obtainability: All required catalogue geometry is local; recorded-sense provenance remains a documented third-party bridge caveat.

ranked.hypothesis: Flight-line-aligned magnetic-edge suppression improves the precision of strand corroboration inside fitted fault damage zones.
layers: visible fault strike and fitted damage-zone distance
ranked.physical_signature: Down-weight coherent magnetic gradients parallel to the documented acquisition direction when no co-located elevation edge exists; retain off-axis or cross-layer-concordant edges.
ranked.why_missing_faults_not_catalogued_faults: A concealed secondary fault can offset magnetized units without a mapped scarp; suppression targets acquisition artifacts rather than merely rediscovering visible fault traces.
ranked.difference_from_repo: The repo tested magnetic-edge relative strike but never an explicit flight-line artifact suppression term or cross-layer edge veto.
ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Low-medium; likely precision gain, limited by 400 m line spacing versus 100 m pixels.
ranked.implementation_cost: Medium; official feature band is local and cached; metadata direction is documented.
ranked.non_fault_mimic: Magnetic dikes, lithologic contacts, leveling residuals, and variable terrain clearance.
ranked.data_obtainability: The hash-pinned TMI band is local. Official page access was previously recorded; this sandbox currently restricts outbound hosts, so no new retrieval was claimed.
